messages:
Avery (product): Quick sync — need a concise launch-readiness checklist for the SOC2 + BYOK pilot with EmberFin. Goal: GA gating decision next week.
Sam (security): Top risks I see: keystore latency causing request timeouts, missing continuity of audit events, and legal-hold extraction latency. Need clear acceptance criteria. :warning:
Rajat (eng-infra): Agree on latency. We ran a sim that showed key unwrap adds ~45ms p95 on 2k reqs/min. We can mitigate with local keystore caching for pinned tenants but need ops controls.
Maya (ops): For oncall, we should add an explicit fallback to managed keys and automated rollback if >1% 5m error rate. Also include an alert runbook link.
Leah (customer-success): EmberFin's SLA requirement: 99.9% availability and audit export within 4 hours on demand. They asked about encrypted export format and chain-of-custody metadata.
Avery (product): Concrete acceptance criteria proposal:
- Audit events emitted for every inference request (request_id, model_version, tenant_id, key_id).
- BYOK handshake completes and stores reference key_id; unwrap latency p95 < 70ms in pilot traffic profile.
- Exportable evidence bundle (JSON + signed manifest) within 4 hours.
- Fallback to managed keys triggers automatically if unwrap errors spike; documented and opt-in for pilot tenants.
Sam (security): Add: audit log integrity check (HMAC) for bundles and retention TTL policy enforcement. Also require a KMS rotation test before GA.
Rajat (eng-infra): Implementation notes: we will:
```
- add prefix-caching of KEK references for pinned tenants
- enable short-lived unwrap tokens with 60s expiry
- batch audit writes to the ingestion pipeline with idempotency keys
```
This reduces unwrap hits and keeps tracing consistent.
Maya (ops): Oncall routing: primary oncall = eng-infra, backup = ops-sre. Escalation: 5m page if error rate >1% or unwrap latency p95 >120ms for 10m. Add a runbook step to flip traffic to managed keys (toggle) + notify legal/customer-success.
Leah (customer-success): We'll need customer-facing wording for the fallback behavior and consent. I'll draft a note: what triggers fallback, expected impact, and how to request manual export for legal hold.
Avery (product): Launch checklist items (draft):
- [ ] Security signoff on HMAC + rotation test (Sam)
- [ ] Performance test: unwrap p95 <70ms under pilot load (Rajat)
- [ ] Export/manifest format agreed and sample exported (Leah + Sam)
- [ ] Runbook + automation for managed-key fallback (Maya)
- [ ] GA gating doc with rollback criteria and customer opt-in flow (Avery)
- [ ] SOC2 control mapping for audit events (Sam)
Sam (security): Also add a regression test: simulate legal-hold extraction and verify manifest integrity and timestamps.
Rajat (eng-infra): Timeline: we can get an infra PR + perf results by EOD Thursday. Need product to confirm pilot tenant list and whether we pin them to a single region.
Avery (product): Pilot tenants: EmberFin + 1 internal. Pin to us-east-1 for now. I’ll update the kickoff doc.
Maya (ops): Ops checklist: deploy canary to 5% traffic, monitor unwrap errors, then 25% after 2 hours with no >0.5% error spikes. Rollback immediately on >1% sustained.
Leah (customer-success): I'll prepare the customer note and consent template. Also collecting EmberFin legal contact for export testing.
DeployBot: Deploy queued: infra/keystore-caching → staging. Expected deploy at 2027-06-15T14:30Z.
Avery (product): Perfect. Next steps: Sam to confirm HMAC spec, Rajat to post perf numbers, Maya to author runbook steps, Leah to send customer communications. Sync in 24h. :calendar:
Sam (security): Will post HMAC spec by EOD.
Rajat (eng-infra): Perf numbers will be in #eng-runtime and I'll paste a short summary here when ready.
Maya (ops): Working on runbook, will include exact toggles + Slack/PagerDuty commands.
Leah (customer-success): Sending EmberFin legal contact now.
Avery (product): Thanks team. If anyone sees an unlisted risk, drop it here.
Sam (security): One more: ensure audit-indexing cost estimate included in GA pricing doc — otherwise finance questions will block. :money_with_wings:
